summary.tldr: Requires the health minister to develop a national school food program and report to Parliament on its design and later review.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Health to work with provincial health and education officials and other stakeholders to develop a school food program for all children in Canada.
Sets out that the program must define healthy food using Canada’s Food Guide, build on existing school food programs, and use best practices from other places.
Requires the minister to assess whether Ottawa should create grants and cost-sharing with provinces so the program has little or no direct cost to children or families.
Promotes evidence-based healthy food education in schools across Canada.
Requires a report on the program within one year, then a review within five years, with both reports tabled in Parliament and posted online.
summary.background: The bill says the program is meant to ensure that all children in Canada have access to healthy food.
